Behind them, the Hive: every window lit again now, every radio playing, every resident awake. In the distance, sirens.
Vera steps away from him. Just one step. Enough.
They look at each other in the rain. There is too much to say, and none of it can be said tonight.
Is Kaneko —
The Hive looks after its own.
She nods. She looks up at the building full of light.

steps.title: Until us
steps.quote: Mara was safe here. Until us.

steps.text: Mara was safe here. Until us.
He has no answer to that. She doesn't need one.
Rain. Ishida comes down the front steps without an umbrella.

steps.title: He knows this car
steps.quote: At the kerb, a black sedan. Engine running. Wipers beating slowly.

steps.text: At the kerb, a black sedan. Engine running. Wipers beating slowly.
He stops. He knows this car.

steps.title: The door opens
steps.quote: A long moment. Then the rear door opens from inside.

steps.text: A long moment. Then the rear door opens from inside.

scenes.title: The lit window
scenes.heading: EXT. POLICE STATION / INT. BLACK SEDAN - CONTINUOUS

steps.title: Only tea
steps.quote: At the foot of the steps, a black sedan waits at the kerb, engine running, wipers going.

steps.text: At the foot of the steps, a black sedan waits at the kerb, engine running, wipers going.
Its rear door stands open: warm amber light, leather.

steps.title: Where are we going
steps.quote: Ishida stands in the rain. He looks back up at the station, at one lit window on the second floor where somebody is still working.

steps.text: Ishida stands in the rain. He looks back up at the station, at one lit window on the second floor where somebody is still working.

steps.title: He drinks
steps.quote: From inside the car, a man's clean hand holds out a cup of tea. The watch from the model.

steps.text: From inside the car, a man's clean hand holds out a cup of tea. The watch from the model.
It's only tea.

steps.title: The door closes
steps.quote: Ishida gets in. The door closes. The rain is suddenly very far away.

steps.text: Ishida gets in. The door closes. The rain is suddenly very far away.

steps.title: Taillights
steps.quote: The black car recedes down a long wet road, its taillights smearing red, exactly like the car in the first scene of the film.

steps.text: The black car recedes down a long wet road, its taillights smearing red, exactly like the car in the first scene of the film.
It turns a corner. Gone.

scenes.title: A minute fast
scenes.heading: INT. POLICE STATION, DETECTIVES' ROOM - MORNING

steps.title: The box
steps.quote: Grey daylight. A cardboard box on Ishida's desk. A young detective is clearing it.

steps.text: Grey daylight. A cardboard box on Ishida's desk. A young detective is clearing it.

steps.title: Empty
steps.quote: He opens the bottom drawer. Empty.

steps.text: He opens the bottom drawer. Empty.
The desk phone rings. He picks it up.

steps.title: He left a statement
steps.quote: He left a statement.

steps.text: Yes. Where? In his own car. Under the expressway. Sitting up, engine off. No marks. He left a statement.
He puts the phone down very slowly. He looks at the empty chair. At the empty drawer.

steps.title: A minute fast
steps.quote: On the wall, the clock still runs a minute fast.

steps.text: On the wall, the clock still runs a minute fast.

scenes.title: The rain has stopped
scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOP OF JACK'S BUILDING - DAY

steps.text: FIVE DAYS LATER

steps.title: The rain has stopped
steps.quote: The rain has stopped for the first time in the film. The sky is pale and washed and enormous.

steps.text: Days later. The rain has stopped for the first time in the film. The sky is pale and washed and enormous.
A small flat roof: laundry poles, a water tank, a single potted plant someone has kept alive. Below, the elevated railway, and the trains going past at eye level.
Jack stands at the railing. He hears the door behind him.
Vera. In a plain coat. Her hair dry.

steps.title: Not close. Not far.
steps.quote: She comes to stand beside him at the railing. Not close. Not far.

steps.text: She comes to stand beside him at the railing. Not close. Not far.
Harada says the prosecutors want you to testify.
Yes.
And your licence?
Gone. It should have gone twenty years ago.
Ishida left a statement. He acted alone.
Is that what it says?
That's what the police say it says.

steps.title: The only eyewitness
steps.quote: Harada has Mara's drawings. The pages from the floor of the bar.

steps.text: Harada has Mara's drawings. The pages from the floor of the bar. She says they're the only eyewitness there is.
She'd have liked that. Being asked.
Nobody asked her. She drew it anyway.
A train passes below. They watch it.

steps.title: This is yours
steps.quote: Jack takes something from his pocket. Holds it out on his open palm. The red bird clip.

steps.text: Jack takes something from his pocket. Holds it out on his open palm.
The red bird clip.
This is yours.
Vera looks at it. She takes it.
She said your father gave it to her. She said you only claim it was yours.

steps.title: Liar
steps.quote: Vera laughs. It comes out broken.

steps.text: Vera laughs. It comes out broken.
Liar. It was mine.
She closes her hand around it.
Jack looks at the trains. It is the hardest thing he will ever say, and he says it simply.

steps.title: At the end
steps.quote: At the end, she asked me to tell you something.

steps.text: At the end, she asked me to tell you something.
Vera goes very still.
She said to tell you she was sorry.
Vera stares at him.
And then she understands. Not the words. What they mean. The fight. The last cruel things she said at the door. The flight home. Everything she has carried since the first scene.
Mara wasn't angry. Mara had forgiven her the whole time.

steps.title: Close enough
steps.quote: Vera turns away to the railing. Her shoulders shake. Jack doesn't touch her. He stands beside her while she cries, the way he knelt beside her in the rain. Close enough. Not closer.

steps.text: Vera turns away to the railing. Her shoulders shake. Jack doesn't touch her. He stands beside her while she cries, the way he knelt beside her in the rain. Close enough. Not closer.
When she can speak:
You could have told me that in the rain.
I couldn't say anything in the rain.
No. Neither could I.

steps.title: They watch it pass
steps.quote: A train. They watch it pass.

steps.text: A train. They watch it pass.
I don't know what we are.
Neither do I.
I still have your lighter.
I know.

steps.title: She doesn't give it back
steps.quote: She takes it from her coat pocket. Looks at it. Opens it. Closes it.

steps.text: She takes it from her coat pocket. Looks at it. Opens it. Closes it.
She doesn't give it back. She puts it away again.
Kaneko's opening a new place. Near the station, under the arches. She's taking the sign.

steps.title: Doesn't look back
steps.quote: She walks to the rooftop door. Stops. Doesn't look back.

steps.text: She walks to the rooftop door. Stops. Doesn't look back.
She says she opens at six.
She goes.

steps.title: His own face
steps.quote: For a moment, in one of the windows, the reflection of his own face.

steps.text: Jack stands alone at the railing. A train passes, its windows full of people. For a moment, in one of the windows, the reflection of his own face.

scenes.title: The Hive coming down, then the plaza
scenes.heading: EXT. THE HIVE / THE PLAZA, WHERE THE HIVE WAS - DAY
scenes.place: THE HIVE / THE PLAZA, WHERE THE HIVE WAS

steps.text: Weeks later.

steps.title: Cut open
steps.quote: The Hive is coming down.

steps.text: The Hive is coming down.
Excavators bite into the walls with long steel jaws. Concrete falls in slow grey curtains. Dust hangs in the air.

steps.title: Exposed to the sky
steps.quote: Rooms stand exposed to the sky, stacked one above another

steps.text: The building has been cut open like the illustrated cross-sections in an old book. Rooms stand exposed to the sky, stacked one above another: a wall of flowered wallpaper, a calendar still pinned beside a window, a mirror, a child's height marks pencilled on a doorframe.
The camera tracks slowly sideways along the ruined face of the building, as it tracked along the lit windows of the living one. Empty room after empty room. We remember who lived in each.

steps.title: Six old stools
steps.quote: At ground level, Kaneko's counter is still standing. Its six old stools in a row.

steps.text: At ground level, Kaneko's counter is still standing. Its six old stools in a row.
At the barrier on the street, a small crowd watches. The radio repairman. The family. The girl with the violin case.

steps.title: The sign
steps.quote: Kaneko stands among them, holding the old noodle-shop sign against her chest, wrapped in a blanket.

steps.text: Kaneko stands among them, holding the old noodle-shop sign against her chest, wrapped in a blanket.
Months later. Winter light, thin and clear. No rain.

steps.title: The plaza
steps.quote: The white plaza from the model, built.

steps.title: Like the painted ones
steps.quote: Real people cross it now, exactly like the painted ones. A strip of new grass. A bench nobody sits on.

steps.text: The white plaza from the model, built. Real people cross it now, exactly like the painted ones. A strip of new grass. A bench nobody sits on.

steps.title: The gardener
steps.quote: Nothing marks where anything was.

steps.text: Nothing marks where anything was.
A tiny place in a brick railway arch near the station. Steam. One warm bulb.
Above the counter, the old hand-painted sign. Faded. Unmistakable.
A train goes over. The bottles tick against each other and settle.

steps.title: The news nobody watches
steps.quote: KUROSE walking into a building between lawyers, cameras flashing, his face composed.

steps.text: On a shelf above the door, a small old television with the sound down: the evening news. KUROSE walking into a building between lawyers, cameras flashing, his face composed. A photograph of ISHIDA in uniform. Then the weather.
Nobody looks up.

steps.title: The third stool
steps.quote: Kaneko ladles. JACK sits at the counter, a bowl in front of him, a space beside him.

steps.text: Kaneko ladles. JACK sits at the counter, a bowl in front of him, a space beside him.
The curtain in the doorway moves. VERA. The red bird clip in her hair.

steps.title: Stool three
steps.quote: She stands a moment. Then she sits down beside him.

steps.text: She stands a moment. Then she sits down beside him.

steps.title: The clip
steps.quote: Kaneko sets a bowl in front of her. Vera eats. All of it.

steps.text: Kaneko sets a bowl in front of her. Vera eats. All of it.
She puts money on the counter. Too much. Kaneko looks at it, then at her, and leaves it where it is.
Past the curtain: a lit window, a radio through a wall, the city going on.

steps.title: She doesnt turn
steps.quote: HOLD on the three of them in the steam.

steps.text: HOLD on the three of them in the steam.
